title: Google Slides Agent Skill Catalog
summary: Runnable capability catalog of Google Slides agent skills, extracted from the supplied catalog document. Each category groups twelve candidate capabilities used for routing, planning, risk gating, specification and coverage scoring.

categories.name: File Lifecycle and Drive Operations
categories.purpose: Control presentation files safely from creation through archiving.

skills.name: Presentation Creation Router
skills.description: Creates a new presentation in the correct Drive location, naming convention, ownership context, and page setup.

skills.name: Open and Recovery Handler
skills.description: Opens existing presentations, detects access or loading issues, and selects a safe recovery path.

skills.name: Slide Import Orchestrator
skills.description: Imports selected slides from another presentation while managing theme, layout, link, and duplicate-content implications.

skills.name: Presentation Copy Manager
skills.description: Creates full-file or selected-slide copies with explicit destination, sharing, and version intent.

skills.name: Drive Move and Rename Coordinator
skills.description: Moves and renames presentations while preserving links, ownership expectations, and dependent workflows.

skills.name: Offline Availability Planner
skills.description: Enables and verifies supported offline use, identifies unavailable online-only features, and prepares reconnection behavior.

skills.name: Version History Checkpoint Manager
skills.description: Names, inspects, restores, and copies versions before risky changes or large automation runs.

skills.name: Presentation Archive Builder
skills.description: Creates a clean archival package containing the approved presentation and required static exports.

skills.name: File Ownership Transfer Planner
skills.description: Evaluates ownership, shared-drive placement, permissions, and continuity before organizational handoff.

skills.name: Duplicate Deck Reconciler
skills.description: Compares near-duplicate presentations and selects, merges, or retires versions without losing approved work.

skills.name: Drive Location Policy Enforcer
skills.description: Checks that files reside in approved My Drive, shared drive, project, or class locations.

skills.name: Presentation Naming Standardizer
skills.description: Applies stable project, audience, date, status, and version naming without breaking discoverability.

categories.name: Sharing, Permissions, and Collaboration
categories.purpose: Enable collaboration without exposing or blocking the work.

skills.name: Viewer Commenter Editor Policy Manager
skills.description: Assigns the least-permissive role that still supports each collaborator's task.

skills.name: Link Sharing Risk Auditor
skills.description: Reviews domain, anyone-with-link, restricted, and public access settings before release.

skills.name: Collaborator Invitation Composer
skills.description: Invites collaborators with clear scope, expected action, deadline, and permission level.

skills.name: Live Coediting Coordinator
skills.description: Partitions slides or components so simultaneous editors avoid collisions and duplicate work.

skills.name: Presence and Edit Conflict Resolver
skills.description: Detects concurrent edits, resolves conflicting changes, and protects the last approved state.

skills.name: Comment Thread Manager
skills.description: Creates, replies to, resolves, and reopens comments while maintaining an actionable review trail.

skills.name: Assignment and Mention Router
skills.description: Assigns comments to responsible collaborators and verifies that mentions can access the file.

skills.name: Activity Dashboard Interpreter
skills.description: Uses permitted viewing activity to understand reach while respecting policy and privacy limits.

skills.name: External Collaborator Access Tester
skills.description: Verifies that recipients outside the organization can open the intended file and linked assets.

skills.name: Collaboration Freeze Controller
skills.description: Temporarily limits editing during final QA, export, or live delivery.

skills.name: Permission Inheritance Analyzer
skills.description: Checks shared-drive, folder, group, and file-level permission interactions.

skills.name: Review Completion Gate
skills.description: Confirms required comments, assignments, approvals, and unresolved issues before publication.

categories.name: Email, Links, Publishing, and Distribution
categories.purpose: Deliver presentations through controlled channels.

skills.name: Collaborator Email Dispatcher
skills.description: Uses Slides email options to notify collaborators without exposing unintended recipients.

skills.name: Presentation Attachment Sender
skills.description: Sends the deck in an appropriate attachment format after checking size, compatibility, and sensitivity.

skills.name: Deep Link Builder
skills.description: Creates links to the presentation, a specific slide, a Drive file, an email address, or an approved website.

skills.name: Internal Slide Navigation Linker
skills.description: Builds next, previous, home, appendix, and section navigation using slide links.

skills.name: Publish-to-Web Privacy Auditor
skills.description: Distinguishes publishing from ordinary sharing and blocks accidental public exposure.

skills.name: Published Playback Configurator
skills.description: Sets advance intervals, looping, restart behavior, and embed parameters for published presentations.

skills.name: Embed Code Packager
skills.description: Produces a website-ready embed with dimensions, privacy notes, and responsive-container guidance.

skills.name: Distribution Format Selector
skills.description: Chooses editable Slides, PPTX, PDF, ODP, TXT, PNG, JPEG, or SVG according to recipient needs.

skills.name: Post-Publication Revocation Planner
skills.description: Removes or replaces published access and verifies that old distribution paths no longer expose content.

skills.name: QR and Short-Link Handoff Planner
skills.description: Creates a reliable audience access path while retaining the canonical unmodified URL in records.

skills.name: Audience Download Policy Manager
skills.description: Balances convenience, editability, and data protection when recipients need local copies.

skills.name: Distribution Integrity Tester
skills.description: Opens every shared, emailed, linked, published, or embedded route as the intended recipient.

skills.name: Print Layout Configurator

skills.name: Custom Poster Slide Designer

skills.name: Social Canvas Variant Builder

skills.name: Print Cost and Ink Simplifier

skills.name: Paint Format Replicator
